hub.tagline: Every row and column has a target sum. Circle the numbers that add up to it — everything else stays out.

all.title: Every row and column has a target
all.desc: The numbers along the right edge and bottom edge are the sums each row and column must reach — counting only the numbers you circle.

all.title: Pen to circle, eraser to cross out
all.desc: Two tools sit above the board. Pen circles a number into the sum; eraser crosses one out to mark it as excluded. Tap a tool, then tap a cell — tap the same mark again to clear it.

all.title: Match every target to win
all.desc: Once every row's and every column's circled-cell sum matches its target, the board is solved. Stuck? Hint reveals one cell for you.

game.legend: pen circles a number into the sum · eraser crosses it out · edges show each target
game.hintFailToast: Every cell is already right where it should be.
game.winSubtitle: Every row and column landed on target — next board unlocked.
